mapper.select: SELECT policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,store_id AS storeId,warehouse_id AS warehouseId, negative_stock_mode AS negativeStockMode,effective_from AS effectiveFrom FROM inv_stock_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND effective_from<=#{effectiveAt} ORDER BY effective_from DESC,policy_version_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT source_event_id AS eventId,request_sha256 AS requestSha256,source_type AS sourceType, source_id AS sourceId,status,affected_lines AS affectedLines,negative_alert AS negativeAlert, applied_at AS appliedAt FROM inv_stock_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_event_id=#{eventId}

SELECT stock_dimension_key AS dimensionKey,warehouse_id AS warehouseId,sku_id AS skuId, stock_status AS stockStatus,on_hand_quantity AS onHandQuantity,reserved_quantity AS reservedQuantity, frozen_quantity AS frozenQuantity,safety_stock_quantity AS safetyStockQuantity, last_ledger_sequence AS lastLedgerSequence,record_version AS recordVersion FROM inv_stock_balance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND stock_dimension_key=#{dimensionKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT stock_dimension_key AS dimensionKey,warehouse_id AS warehouseId,sku_id AS skuId, stock_status AS stockStatus,on_hand_quantity AS onHandQuantity,reserved_quantity AS reservedQuantity, frozen_quantity AS frozenQuantity,safety_stock_quantity AS safetyStockQuantity, last_ledger_sequence AS lastLedgerSequence,record_version AS recordVersion FROM inv_stock_balance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND stock_status='SALEABLE'

SELECT ledger_id AS ledgerId,ledger_sequence AS ledgerSequence,stock_dimension_key AS dimensionKey, warehouse_id AS warehouseId,sku_id AS skuId,movement_type AS movementType, quantity_before AS quantityBefore,quantity_delta AS quantityDelta,quantity_after AS quantityAfter, source_type AS sourceType,source_id AS sourceId,source_line_id AS sourceLineId, policy_version_id AS policyVersionId,occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM inv_stock_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND stock_dimension_key=#{dimensionKey} ORDER BY ledger_sequence ASC
